change_type_taxonomy.EXEMPTION_ADDED: A new exemption from an existing rule is introduced
change_type_taxonomy.STANDARD_UPDATED: An Indian Standard (IS) or AIS reference is upgraded to a newer version
change_type_taxonomy.OMISSION: An existing rule or sub-rule is deleted entirely
change_type_taxonomy.CONSEQUENTIAL_AMENDMENT: A change made to one rule as a direct consequence of a change in another rule
change_type_taxonomy.SAFETY_STANDARD_ADDED: A new mandatory safety compliance standard is imposed on a vehicle category
change_type_taxonomy.REGISTRATION_RULE_ADDED: A new or clarified vehicle registration requirement
change_type_taxonomy.EDITORIAL_CORRECTION: A non-substantive correction to headings, text, or cross-references
change_type_taxonomy.NEW_PROCEDURE: A new administrative or procedural rule introduced
